levels.name: Level 1: Python Foundations
levels.description: Master core syntax, dynamic typing, and fundamental data types.

milestones.title: Introduction to Python
milestones.description: Python overview, syntax, interpreted execution, and print statement.

milestones.title: Variables & Typing
milestones.description: Dynamic typing, variable assignment, naming rules, and references.

milestones.title: Numeric Operators & Booleans
milestones.description: Ints, floats, division vs floor division (/, //), and booleans.

levels.name: Level 2: Collections & Data Structures
levels.description: Work with strings, lists, dictionaries, tuples, and sets.

milestones.title: Strings & Immutability
milestones.description: String indexing, slicing, methods, and character immutability.

milestones.title: Lists & List Operations
milestones.description: Zero-indexed mutable lists, append(), slice syntax, and copying.

milestones.title: Dictionaries & Key Lookups
milestones.description: Hashable keys, key-value mappings, and get() method.

milestones.title: Tuples & Sets
milestones.description: Immutable tuples and unique unordered set collections.

levels.name: Level 3: Logic, Loops & Functions
levels.description: Implement conditional branching, loops, and reusable modular functions.

milestones.title: Conditionals & Loops
milestones.description: If-elif-else branching, range() loops, break, and continue.

milestones.title: Functions & Default Arguments
milestones.description: def syntax, return values, parameters, and default argument traps.

levels.name: Level 4: Object-Oriented Programming
levels.description: Model complex entities with classes, methods, and inheritance.

milestones.title: Classes & Attributes
milestones.description: Defining classes, __init__ initializer, and self instance reference.

milestones.title: Inheritance & Types
milestones.description: Subclassing, method overriding, and isinstance() checks.

levels.name: Level 5: Error Handling & Modules
levels.description: Write resilient code with try/except and organize multi-file programs.

milestones.title: Exceptions & Error Handling
milestones.description: try, except, else, and finally resource cleanup.
